title: 第7章 落水
slug: 驱鬼道长全本免费-驱鬼道长最新章节列表
content_zh:
我说你别墨迹没用的，你小子上我家不也翻墙吗，今天赶上周末不用上学，咱们去哪玩。
铁柱一听到玩就来劲了，说咱们去小湾子抓鱼去吧，好长时间没去那了，顺便叫上二蛋，那小子有渔网，抓鱼的话得把他叫上。
我说行，随后铁柱锁上大门，我俩又向二蛋家跑去，二蛋当时正趴在板凳上写作业，一听去抓鱼，把作业胡乱的装进书包，乐的屁颠屁颠就去拿网了。带好装备，我们一行三人嘻嘻哈哈的向小湾子跑去。
小湾子就在村子外的山脚下，是一个天然形成的大水塘，三面环山，这时正赶上中午，火辣辣的烈日当头照，不远处，已经有好几个小孩在那散网抓鱼了。
不过即使这么热的天儿，也没有人敢下水洗澡，因为我们村的大人说过，小湾子存在的年头久远，而且水还深，天长地久的，指不定底下生出什么乱七八糟的东西呢。
所以大人都吓唬自家的小孩，千万别下水洗澡，说小湾子底下住着一条鲤鱼精，专抓小孩子，吸脑浆，谁要下去，就会被它抓走。
铁柱我们三个，在岸边的一棵大柳树阴凉处坐下，开始捣鼓手中的渔网，这渔网也没啥特别的，用铁丝做成一个圈，然后在用纱布糊上，就成了一个筒子形状。
渔网上细下粗，鱼儿要是钻进去，那是只进不出，就靠这个，小湾子的鱼没少栽在我们三个手上。
我们在渔网上拴好一根绳子，又向网里放了点碎馒头和一块石头，随后抓住绳子一头，把网用力一甩，扔进了大水塘里面，网里面有石头，在水里咕隆隆冒几个泡就沉入水底。
做完这些，我们就在岸边等着，鱼闻到馒头的香味会进渔网吃，到一定的时间，我们把网拉上来，就等着丰收了。
这时二蛋抓住绳子，防止网被水冲走，我和铁柱去捡柴火生火，一会网到鱼，我们打算就地生火烤着吃。
大约过了十分钟左右，二蛋见时间差不多了，就开始往上拉绳子，不过奇怪的事情发生了，无论他怎么用力，那网就是拉不回来，纹丝不动。
我和铁柱一见，赶紧跑过去和他一起拉，使出了吃奶的力气，硬是没拉动。
二蛋又拉了几下，就把绳子递给我，挠了挠头，说：“双喜你帮我抓住绳子，网应该是被水下的树根挂住了，我下去解下来。”
我连忙说:“这里水太深，听大人说下面还有鲤鱼精呢，要不这网咱不要了行吗？”
二蛋一脸的不在乎，牛逼轰轰的说：“不行，渔网可是我的宝贝，怎么能说丢就丢呢，在说，我二蛋号称浪里白跳，水上小蛟龙，区区一条鲤鱼精我还没放在心上。”
我见他牛逼吹的挺大，无奈的摇了摇头，也只好随他去了，况且大人的话我也不怎么相信，他们之所以不让我们下水无非是怕被淹死，鲤鱼精什么的都是他们瞎编乱造吓唬我们这群孩子用的。
二蛋脱了鞋子和衣服，伸伸胳膊，拉了拉腿，猛跑几步，一个猛子就扎进水里，扑棱棱的向渔网那游去。
我一看他的泳姿就噗嗤一声笑了，这小子刚刚还吹嘘自己是浪里白条呢，就他那游泳的动作，整个就一个大癞蛤蟆在那瞎扑腾水么。
我和铁柱坐在岸边，笑嘻嘻的看着二蛋去解渔网，还不忘喊他一声：“二蛋，顺便看看网里的鱼够不够吃一顿的。”

二蛋说好咧，一头扎进水里，不一会，他举着渔网就钻出水面，向我们喊道：“哈哈，这次有的吃了，除了一些小杂鱼，还有一条大鲤子呢。”
我和铁柱一看，那渔网里还真有一条大鲤子，少说也得有三斤，顿时笑得合不拢嘴，心想这回有得吃了。
就在二蛋在水中得意洋洋举着渔网显摆的时候，我突然发现他身后的水下有个模模糊糊的黑影向它靠近。
我当时就吓了一跳，卧槽，不会真的有鲤鱼精吧。
不过等那黑影游近我仔细一看，顿时松了口气，虚惊一场呀，原来那黑影是一个扎着马尾辫的小女孩。
这小女孩五六岁左右，穿着红色的小肚兜，因为她在水里的缘故，我一时没看清她的样貌。
当时我就奇怪了，这是谁家的孩子在这洗澡？大人也不管管，也不怕淹死了。

content_en:
I said it's useless to stop ink. Why don't you climb over the wall when you come to my house? Today is the weekend and we don't have to go to school. Where can we go to play?
Tie Zhu got excited when he heard about the game and said, let's go to Xiaowanzi to catch fish. I haven't been there for a long time. I called Erdan by the way. That guy has a fishing net. If you want to catch fish, you have to call him.
I said yes, then Tie Zhu locked the door, and we ran to Erdan's house again. Erdan was lying on the bench doing homework. When he heard that he was going to catch fish, he put the homework into his schoolbag indiscriminately, and went to get the net happily. After gathering our equipment, the three of us happily ran towards Xiaowanzi.
Xiaowanzi is at the foot of the mountain outside the village. It is a large naturally formed pond, surrounded by mountains on three sides. It was noon and the scorching sun was shining brightly. Not far away, several children were already casting nets to catch fish.
But even on such a hot day, no one dared to take a bath in the water, because the adults in our village said that the small bay has been around for a long time, and the water is still deep, and it lasts forever, so there may be something messy underneath.
Therefore, adults scare their children not to take a bath in the water, saying that there is a carp spirit living under the cove, which specializes in catching children and sucking their brains. Anyone who wants to go down will be snatched away by it.
The three of us, Tie Zhu, sat down in the shade of a big willow tree on the shore and began to tinker with the fishing net in our hands. This fishing net was nothing special. We made a circle with wire, and then we pasted it with gauze to form a tube shape.
The fishing net is thin and thick at the bottom. If a fish gets in, it can only get in but not get out. With this, many fish from the small bay have fallen into the hands of the three of us.
We tied a rope on the fishing net, and put some broken steamed buns and a stone into the net. Then we grabbed one end of the rope, swung the net hard, and threw it into the large pond. There were stones in the net, which rumbled and bubbled a few times before sinking to the bottom.
After doing this, we waited on the shore. When the fish smelled the aroma of the steamed buns, they would enter the fishing net and eat it. At a certain time, we would pull up the net and wait for the harvest.
At this time, Erdan grabbed the rope to prevent the net from being washed away by the water. Tie Zhu and I went to collect firewood and make a fire. After a while, we caught fish in the net, and we planned to make a fire and roast it on the spot.
About ten minutes later, when Erdan saw that time was almost up, he started to pull the rope upwards, but something strange happened. No matter how hard he tried, the net could not be pulled back and it would not move at all.
As soon as Tie Zhu and I saw each other, I quickly ran over and pulled with him. I tried my best to not pull him.
Erdan pulled the rope a few more times, then handed me the rope, scratched his head and said, "Shuangxi, help me grab the rope. The net is probably caught by the roots of the underwater tree. I'll go down and untie it."
I quickly said: "The water here is too deep. I heard from adults that there are carp spirits down there. How about we not need this net?"
Erdan looked unconcerned and said loudly: "No, the fishing net is my treasure, how can I just throw it away? After all, I, Erdan, are known as jumping in the waves for nothing, a little dragon on the water, and I don't even care about a carp spirit."
I saw that he was bragging a lot, so I shook my head helplessly and had no choice but to let him go. Besides, I didn't really believe what the adults said. The reason why they didn't let us go into the water was just because they were afraid of drowning. The carp spirit and so on were just made up to scare us children.
Erdan took off his shoes and clothes, stretched his arms, pulled his legs, ran a few steps, plunged into the water, and swam towards the fishing net.
When I saw his swimming style, I burst out laughing. This kid had just boasted that he was a prostitute in the waves, but his swimming movements were just like a big toad splashing around in the water.
Tie Zhu and I were sitting on the shore, smiling as we watched Er Dan untie the fishing net. We didn't forget to call him, "Er Dan, by the way, check to see if the fish in the net are enough for a meal."
Erdan said yes and dove into the water., and after a while, he came out of the water holding the fishing net and shouted to us: "Haha, we ate some this time. In addition to some small miscellaneous fish, there is also a big carp."
Tie Zhu and I took a look and saw that there was really a big carp in the fishing net, weighing at least three kilograms. We immediately laughed from ear to ear, thinking that we would get something to eat this time.
Just as Erdan was proudly holding up his fishing net in the water to show off, I suddenly noticed a vague black figure approaching him under the water behind him.
I was shocked at the time. Damn it, there couldn’t really be a carp spirit.
But when the black shadow came closer and I took a closer look, I was relieved and it was a false alarm. It turned out that the black shadow was a little girl with a ponytail.
This little girl was about five or six years old and was wearing a red bellyband. Because she was in the water, I couldn't see her appearance clearly for a while.
I was surprised at that time, whose child was taking a bath here? The adults don't care, and they are not afraid of drowning.
